question: After the no-op pacing defect is fixed, should outbound recovery keep no-adapter ambiguous entries pending/backed off instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove the mechanics, but the choice between future recoverability and a clearer fail-closed operator state is a product/operations decision.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after repair if maintainers want ambiguous entries to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or a broader delivery ledger exists.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer current main's terminal failed behavior until the full delivery-state design is ready.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API surface before letting ambiguous entries remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after repair if maintainers want ambiguous entries to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation or a broader delivery ledger exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the most recent broad outbound recovery rewrite that the pending-state decision builds on.
